name: OTHER Industries Custom Screen Printing & Embroidery
old_description: OTHER Industries is a studio specializing in custom screen printing, embroidery, promo products and bulk wholesale apparel production located in Wilmington, Delaware. With over 10 years of experience, we produce high quality custom printed t-shirts, branded merchandise, and large scale production runs with fast, reliable turnaround times. We are a trusted vendor for brands, businesses, and organizations that need consistent results and dependable production.
about:
OTHER Industries operates as a custom apparel production studio in Wilmington, Delaware. The business began in a basement where the founders printed shirts for their own clothing projects, gradually evolving into a full-scale production studio rooted in streetwear culture, graphic design, and independent music scenes.

The studio specializes in screen printing and embroidery, offering plastisol, water-based, and discharge inks along with specialty options such as puff, glow-in-the-dark, metallic, and high-density inks. It provides end-to-end services including garment sourcing, artwork preparation, digital proofing, sewing, finishing, folding, and packaging. Production is handled entirely in-house by experienced printers who manage screen setup, printing, and quality control. The shop focuses on bulk orders of 24 pieces or more and accommodates large-scale wholesale runs.

Clients span clothing brands, restaurants and coffee shops, construction and trade companies, schools and universities, corporate organizations, artists and bands, festivals and live events, nonprofits and community organizations, breweries and hospitality groups, and retail merchandise programs. The studio also serves marketing agencies and independent designers seeking branded merchandise and promotional products.

The founders chose the name OTHER Industries to signal a departure from traditional print shops, aiming to build a studio more connected to design, culture, and independent brands. They emphasize a hands-on, craft-oriented approach influenced by DIY printmaking communities in Philadelphia, with a dedicated sales representative for each order and a commitment to consistent, reliable production.
